Analyst 2: News Momentum Analyst (aggressive) — evaluates headline sentiment, sector news momentum, keyword frequency shifts, market sentiment indicators, corporate disclosures. Analyst 3: Risk Manager (defensive) — evaluates CB Score, portfolio P&L, position size limits, market volatility, correlation risk, FX/commodity impact. The CB Score (Circuit Breaker, 0-100) composites: KOSPI short-term trend (25%), volatility 10-day ATR (25%), USD/KRW stability (25%), market sentiment proxy (25%).
